entries.dialogueText: Several days had passed since I ordered the investigation into my secretary, Livia Suno.

entries.title: Narrator: "Several days had passed since the c..."
entries.dialogueText: Several days had passed since the confrontation with Petr, Livia and Lucian in my office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian was still acting frosty towa..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian was still acting frosty towards me for rejecting his advice. On the other hand, both Petr and Livia were unnaturally nice to me, though they avoided speaking to each other.

entries.title: Narrator: "Both Petr and Livia had been acting..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Petr and Livia had been acting unnaturally nice to me, believing I'd let them off the hook for their affair. They seemed to be avoiding each other in the hallways, though.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was just settling in behind my de..."
entries.dialogueText: I was just settling in behind my desk when Lucian knocked on my door.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, a moment of your time?""
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, a moment of your time?"

entries.speaker: Player

entries.menuText: "Of course."

entries.title: Player_Italic: "I motioned for him to come in. He s..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I still believe you were wrong not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still believe you were wrong not to pursue an investigation into Miss Suno. However, I acknowledge my lack of concrete evidence and unorthodox information gathering method may have given you pause."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Unorthodox? You surveilled Petr be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unorthodox? You surveilled Petr behind my back!"
entries.menuText: "Unorthodox? You surveilled Petr behind my back!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're not going to change my mind..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not going to change my mind about this."
entries.menuText: "You're not going to change my mind about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I could have been less rude to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could have been less rude to you about it, though."
entries.menuText: "I could have been less rude to you about it, though."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Perhaps.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I feel I would be failing in my du..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel I would be failing in my duties as a chief strategist not to give you one last piece of advice on this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That isn't my goal.""
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't my goal."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have already apologized to Mr. V..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have already apologized to Mr. Vectern for the intrusion. It won't happen again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked me in the eye."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Please, consider dismissing Miss S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, consider dismissing Miss Suno from her position at the palace. Just in case I am right after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you crazy? She'll go public ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you crazy? She'll go public about the affair."
entries.menuText: "Are you crazy? She'll go public about the affair."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't. She's so good at her job!""
entries.dialogueText: "I can't. She's so good at her job!"
entries.menuText: "I can't. She's so good at her job!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, she has been a distraction t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, she has been a distraction to Petr..."
entries.menuText: "Well, she has been a distraction to Petr..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How do I justify that to her?""
entries.dialogueText: "How do I justify that to her?"
entries.menuText: "How do I justify that to her?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""She slept with the vice president...."
entries.dialogueText: "She slept with the vice president. Extremely unprofessional behavior."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Her looks may be unmatched, but he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her looks may be unmatched, but her skills most certainly are not."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That might make a headline or two,..."
entries.dialogueText: "That might make a headline or two, but it won't sink your administration. Unlike a potential uncontrolled intelligence leak to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. If it'll get you off my..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If it'll get you off my case, I'll fire her right now."
entries.menuText: "All right. If it'll get you off my case, I'll fire her."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. I won't continue to indulge yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I won't continue to indulge your paranoid fantasies. Livia stays."
entries.menuText: "No. I won't continue to indulge your paranoid fantasies. Livia stays."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Keeping Mr. Vectern around may be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keeping Mr. Vectern around may be another mistake. But that's a conversation for another time."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BaseGame.Relations_Lucian_Opinion -= 2

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked as if he was about to..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked as if he was about to object one last time, but then smiled thinly.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As you wish. I won't bring this up..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish. I won't bring this up any further."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He walked out and closed the door b..."
entries.dialogueText: He walked out and closed the door behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I called Livia into my office. She..."
entries.dialogueText: I called Livia into my office. She tentatively stepped in.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""What is it, Mr. President?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought about how useful she'd be..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about how useful she'd been to me as a secretary -- and how much she knew about what I'd done.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nothing. Go back to work.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. Go back to work."
entries.menuText: "Nothing. Go back to work."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're fired, Livia.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're fired, Livia."
entries.menuText: "You're fired, Livia."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""W-what? I thought we'd been over a..."
entries.dialogueText: "W-what? I thought we'd been over all this..."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Um... okay. Just let me know if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Um... okay. Just let me know if you need anything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're making Petr too distracted..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're making Petr too distracted to work."
entries.menuText: "You're making Petr too distracted to work."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia walked back out. Lucian looke..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia walked back out. Lucian looked at me in disbelief for a moment, then smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You've made your point, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've made your point, Mr. President. I won't trouble you with this any further."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're too ambitious for this job...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're too ambitious for this job. Go get a proper university education."
entries.menuText: "You're too ambitious for this job. Go get a proper university education."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't share Lucian's suspicions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't share Lucian's suspicions that you're a spy, but I can't take the risk that he's right."
entries.menuText: "I don't share Lucian's suspicions that you're a spy, but I can't take the risk that he's right."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your performance has been abysmal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your performance has been abysmal lately."
entries.menuText: "Your performance has been abysmal lately."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I know that's not true.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know that's not true."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She glared at Lucian, then at me."
entries.dialogueText: She glared at Lucian, then at me.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Then perhaps you should fire him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then perhaps you should fire him."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""How prudent of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "How prudent of you."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""That's the best you could come up..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the best you could come up with?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I hope you're both happy. You've r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you're both happy. You've ruined a woman's career simply because she acted too much like a man."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stormed out, slamming the door..."
entries.dialogueText: She stormed out, slamming the door behind her.

entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No. My drunken idiocy got us into..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. My drunken idiocy got us into this mess in the first place."

entries.dialogueText: "It's going to be a whole new me from now on, Anton. I promise."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's... wow. I can't believe you..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""To new beginnings.""
entries.dialogueText: "To new beginnings."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He drained a third of the bottle in one long swig, then got to his feet and unsteadily made his way to the door.
